The moon of ''[[Ishdaga (world)|Ishdaga]]'' is the fourth [[moon]] of the small [[gas giant]] [[Sigdashku]] in the [[Kaggushus]] System.  It is controlled by the [[Kaggushus Intermural Finance Foundation]] (KIFF) which operates a number of industrial facilities.  Public tours and visits are welcomed and even encouraged by [[Kaggushus Intermural Finance Foundation|KIFF]].  A number of antebellum {{TL|16}} facilities remain in near pristine condition, and [[Kaggushus Intermural Finance Foundation|KIFF]] is using the proceeds from paid tours and public donations to fund future salvage operations.

== Description / Astrography & Planetology == 
The moon of ''[[Ishdaga (world)|Ishdaga]]'' is the fourth moon of the small [[gas giant]] [[Sigdashku]] in the [[Kaggushus]] System.  It has an exotic [[atmosphere]] composed of an unusual gas mix which requires the use of oxygen tanks, but protective suits are not needed.

== History & Background / Dossier ==
''[[Ishdaga (world)|Ishdaga]]'' is controlled by the [[Kaggushus Intermural Finance Foundation]] (KIFF) which operates a number of industrial facilities.  Public tours and visits are welcomed and even encouraged by [[Kaggushus Intermural Finance Foundation|KIFF]].  A number of antebellum {{TL|16}} facilities remain in near pristine condition, and [[Kaggushus Intermural Finance Foundation|KIFF]] is using the proceeds from paid tours and public donations to fund future salvage operations.

''[[Ishdaga (world)|Ishdaga]]'' is also home to the [[Uumgadi (star)|Uumgadi]] Co-Prosperity Development Trust, in which the [[Kaggushus Intermural Finance Foundation]] plays a significant role.  This [[Zirunkariish]] subsidiary that is committed to economic development of the [[Kaggushus (world)|Kaggushus System]] through direct investment and other projects anywhere within the Kaggushus system, except on the mainworld of Kaggushus and the worlds of Gankhaka and Liilirsi.  It is headquartered on [[Ishdaga (world)|Ishdaga]].  Ownership: [[Zirunkariish]]--50%, [[Shiishuginsa family]]--15%, [[Hortalez et Cie]]--10%, and [[Kaggushus Intermural Finance Foundation]]--25%.

''[[Ishdaga (world)|Ishdaga]]'' has [[Zirunkariish]] offices that include a major trading clearinghouse, and both the [[Massilia Sector]] and [[Kerr Subsector]] headquarters offices.

[[Trans Galactic Starlines]], in partnership with [[Vilani]] [[megacorporation]] [[Zirunkariish]] have set-up alternate starports for ease of access and use with connecting in-system service provided to passengers.  In the [[Kaggushus (world)|Kaggushus]] system, [[Ishdaga (world)|Ishdaga]] is used.  This alternate starport has a [[Brubek's]] gastropub and a [[Medel's Mega Mart]].
